text: Mutation rate, time emergence selection coefficient subclones calculated. values calculated based population genetics model tumour evolution see Williams et al. 2016 2018 details (Nature Genetics). mutation rate scaled probability lineage survival \(\beta\), \(\mu/\beta\) given : $$\mu/\beta = M / (1/fmin - 1/fmax)$$ \(fmin\) minimum VAF \(fmax\) maximum, \(M\) number mutations \(fmin\) \(fmax\).
